0022600023.text: The Lakers (4-1, first in the Pacific) visit the Warriors (2-3, 10th in the West) for their sixth game of the season, with Los Angeles 2-0 on the road and riding a one-game winning streak. Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation), and Ziaire Williams is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision, while Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), with Gui Santos day-to-day with knee tendinitis and also a game-time decision. The Lakers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 127-105 win in Los Angeles on October 21, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
